_note: NFL jerseys from nfl-cyq888 (catalog/sources/nfl-cyq888), 2026-10-04. The owner sent the catalog and chose the prices (adults ₪139, kids ₪89), a selection of each team's stars, and "live on the site after our check". Each studio render was compared with its supplier photo; 12 were mended locally and 17 held for a new render. Products were created as DRAFT with productSet, read back (price, 4 sizes × 5 units, media), then set ACTIVE and published to the Online Store. English and Arabic registered for every product and its size option; adult and kids versions linked with sportwear.counterpart; filter names set. 101 picks wait for renders (OpenAI credit) and 17 for a new render: catalog/sources/nfl-cyq888/status.json.

collections._note: Smart collections, on the Online Store, sorted MANUAL by scripts/catalog/collection-order.py. Titles and descriptions in he/en/ar (catalog/translations/store-content.json).

menus.translations: en/ar registered for the 37 new links, the 3 new hidden child lists (NFL, חולצות NFL, קפוצ׳ונים), the 4 hoodie links that lost theirs when they moved, and the 4 clubs moved to ליגות נוספות on 2026-09-28 (West Ham, Wolves, Burnley, Girona), which had lost theirs then.
